runtime_contract.select_level: Load selected independent scene directly; all unlocked, no level-completion prerequisite
runtime_contract.hud: One nearby-object action line. Hidden when no target. Optional location label; never a checklist.
runtime_contract.help: Tab shows controls only, not task guidance
runtime_contract.leave: Always available. Do not require all gags/photos/items. No success/fail result UI.
runtime_contract.photo: Optional, explicit local save. Show success only after disk write confirmation; no auto network sharing.
runtime_contract.trigger: Proximity/look/E as each scene gag config specifies; one local performance at a time; player may continue walking
runtime_contract.quiet_rule: 20s environmental quiet is a pacing suggestion, never a gate or timer
runtime_contract.difficulty: Observation layering and multi-object linkage only; no puzzle penalties
